description: You're near the rear entrance of a house, to the south. Trails enter the jungle to the east and the west.
title: Back Door

description: A solitary black circle is the only break in an vaste expanse of whiteness extending to the horizon. Like a dark speck in a sea of white, or a huge piece of typing paper with but a single period typed upon it, this black circle seems to have been placed here entirely as an opportunity for some silly literary allusions. To avoid the danger of accidentally typing an "L" and having to read them again, follow the faint trails to the north or east.
title: Allusion Room

description: No living creature can even guess how long this storehouse has sat amidst the catacombs, undisturbed by man or by time, untouched by wars and weather, a silent witness to the passing eons, the rise and fall of empires, the births and deaths of countless billions, its only visitor the dark waters of a Martian canal.
title: Forgotten Storehouse

description: You suddenly find yourself longing for the slime pits of Venus or the sandstorms of Mars. This particular section of Cleveland has exits to the northeast and south.
title: Cleveland

description: An undistinguished bar, yet the social center of Upper Sandusky. The front door is almost lost amidst the hazy maze of neon that shrouds the grimy glass of the south wall. Doors marked "Ladies" and "Gents" lead, respectively, northeast and northwest.
title: Joe's Bar

description: This rickety home is so petite that the entire first floor is only one location in this story. When you tire of this floor, you can go east, southwest, or up.
title: Teensy-Weensy House

description: You are standing near the front stoop of a very large igloo. Its door is flanked by a faded sign and a barred window. Paths lead north, north and north.
title: South Pole

description: As with all Martian civilization, this once-fashionable shopping center has fallen upon hard times; the only store to have endured the fifteen-millenia recession lies to the south. The canal is still as visible as it was when scheming marketeers misnamed the mall generations ago -- in other words, not at all. A path leads east, and a dune to the west seems mountable.
title: Canalview Mall

description: To the north: the entrance to a plasticoid house, the only type of structure that lasts more than three minutes in the volatile Venusian biosphere. To the south and east: paths into the jungle.
title: Front Door

description: Damp walls of brick rise to a point of light far above. A black circle is visible just below the surface of the water.
title: Well Bottom

description: This store is in good shape only relative to the other shops in the mall; for example, the last time it was vacuumed, humans were just inventing writing. The dust nearly covers the proprietor, who sits forlornly in the corner beneath a faded sign. An exit is barely visible through the dust to the north.
title: Exit Shop

description: By standing erect at the parapet of this mighty tower, you command an exciting view. Below, gardens and courtyards intermingle with the palace buildings, forming a fertile oasis in the Martian desert. Off to the west, docks straddle a deep canal. On the far shore, sand dunes lap at crumbling buildings. On the top step of a winding stair is a black circle.
title: Minaret

description: No, not a typo. "Dessert" refers to the fifty foot Martian Cream Pie here. A mirage, of course. People hopelessly lost in the desert often see strange mirages, such as cream pies, lakes, or trails to the northwest and southeast.
title: Martian Dessert

description: This spot is much like the rest of the catacombs, except that a ladder leads up into the darkness.
title: Ladder Room

description: This is the campsite of a family of nomadic robotic gypsies. A ragged tent is pitched on the north side of the camp, and trails lead northwest and south.
title: Gypsy Camp

description: Generations of Sultans and Sultanesses are entombed here, along with their vast wealth, their favorite servants, and some form of transportation to the next world. For example, one Sultan lies amidst mountains of rubies, surrounded by a fleet of dirigibles.
title: Burial Chamber
